plan.goal: Log in, add the Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart, and proceed through checkout to the order overview page.

steps.note: Enter the username on the Swag Labs login page. Use the fixed login credential from the recording, not per-row data.
Enter the password. The login page states the password for all users is secret_sauce. Use the fixed login credential from the recording, not per-row data.
Submit the login form and open the Products page.
Click the Add to cart button under Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) on the Products page.
Open the cart using the Cart link at the top right. After adding an item its badge shows 1 item, so it is named by the stable part Cart.
Proceed from the Your Cart page to checkout information.
Enter the first name on Checkout: Your Information.
Enter the last name on Checkout: Your Information.
Enter the zip/postal code. The digits are small in the recording, so the row value is the best reading shown; confirm the exact original zip if it matters for a repeat.
Submit the checkout information and proceed to the order overview. The recording ends on that overview page; the Finish button is visible there but no Finish click is shown.
Verify the Checkout: Overview page shows the backpack, payment and shipping information, and the $32.39 total.

plan.expected_effect: The Checkout: Overview page is shown listing Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99), Payment Information: SauceCard #31337, Shipping Information: Free Pony Express Delivery, and Price Total: $32.39 (Item total: $29.99, Tax: $2.40, Total: $32.39), with Cancel and Finish buttons visible.
